generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's decurrent tree species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).
The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.
The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's shrub species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full, as Leguminosae: calyx synsepalous, 5-toothed or cleft; corolla of 5 petals, regular or somewhat irregular or commonly papilionaceous (so symmetry is each genus's); stamens 10, monadelphous, diadelphous or distinct (Acacia numerous); pistil 1, superior, 1-celled.
